data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month. Fisher01–25: opt in individually, not all-or-nothing. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each of you: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
